title: OFM live line KPIs
description: Payload of {enterprise}/{site}/{area}/{line}/kpi/hour, .../kpi/day and .../kpi/order: the line's KPIs for the current hour, today (site local time) and the running work order, so far. Calculated by the database from the history (hist.fn_live_line_kpi, ADR-0008) and republished retained by the runtime every minute. The order topic is cleared (empty retained message) while no order is running.

ts.description: Time the KPIs were calculated. Republished every minute, so an old ts means the runtime cannot read the database (ADR-0007).

period.description: Which period the KPIs cover; the same as the last topic level.

fromTs.description: Start of the period (the order's start for order).

toTs.description: End of the period so far (the calculation time).

performance.description: Total units x ideal cycle time / running time. Above 1 means the rated speed is set too low (see performanceOver100).

good.description: Good units counted at the line's output machine in scheduled time.

reject.description: Rejected units from the constraint to the output machine in scheduled time.

unaccountedS.description: Seconds of scheduled time with no usable state (unknown, or no data). Above zero, the KPIs rest on incomplete data.

performanceOver100.description: True when performance is above 1 in the period.

kpiRuleId.description: ID of the line KPI rule (config.line_kpi_rule) the KPIs were calculated with.

ratio.description: A ratio, 1 = 100 %. Null when it cannot be calculated: no planned production time yet, no units, or no ideal cycle time (no work order ever ran on the line).
